origin.description: Test whether an object is a zoo series.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Any object. A regular zooreg series is a zoo series.

origin.details: The test is inheritance of the class zoo. A zooreg series inherits zoo, so it is included.
origin.value: TRUE when object inherits from zoo, otherwise FALSE.

translation.description: Test whether an object is a zoo series.

arguments.name: object
arguments.text: Any object. A regular series is a zoo series.

translation.details: The test is whether the object is a Zoo. A series created with a frequency is regular and is still a Zoo.
translation.value: True when object is a Zoo, otherwise False.
translation.example:
import math
import sys

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/zoo")
from zoo.zoo_class import aggregate_zoo, ifelse_zoo, is_zoo, median_zoo, quantile_zoo, rev_zoo, xtfrm_zoo, zoo


def show(value):
    if isinstance(value, (bool, np.bool_)):
        print("TRUE" if value else "FALSE")
        return
    if is_zoo(value):
        show(value.data)
        show(value.index)
        return
    array = np.asarray(value, dtype=float).ravel(order="F")
    print(" ".join("NA" if math.isnan(float(item)) else format(float(item), ".16g") for item in array))

show(is_zoo(zoo([1, float('nan'), 3], [1, 2, 3])))
